PROP-57888860-inv-003.text: Commitment deduplication must preserve semantic equivalence — mapping indices must be bijective per unique commitment.
PROP-57888860-inv-003.assertion: forall dedup(comms_bytes): forall i,j: comms_bytes[i] == comms_bytes[j] <=> commitment_indices[i] == commitment_indices[j]

locations.note: Deduplicates commitments using HashMap, creating bijective mapping: each unique commitment gets a unique index, and identical commitments map to the same index
Calls deduplicate_with_indices to produce deduplicated_commitments and row_indices (commitment_indices) before batch verification
